ui.title: Museo Real Alto

ui.title: Real Alto Museum
ui.subtitle: Interactive Augmented Reality Guide
ui.description: Discover three-dimensional archaeological replicas and interactive history directly in the museum open area.

marker-hiro.title: Valdivia Culture Figure
